title: Manners when eating
intro: The Prophet (SAW) taught us how to eat: Bismillah, the right hand, and what is in front of you.

learn.html: Every people has a religion or culture that has left a mark on every part of life – also on eating. Islam has taught us manners for eating, too, through the practice of Muhammad (SAW).

items: make sure the food and drink are halal, with nothing haram or doubtful
let the host or the oldest family member start first
eat from what is in front of you
be content with the food prepared
do not eat food that is too hot
wash the hands, mouth and teeth

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said to ‘Umar ibn Abi Salamah: “Young man, mention Allah’s name, eat with your right hand, and eat from what is in front of you!” (Bukhari)

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: If we forget to say Bismillah at the start, when we remember we say: Bismillaahi fee awwalihee wa aakhirihee – in the name of Allah at its beginning and its end.
